name: Oregon Golf Club
architects: Peter Jacobsen and Jim Hardy with Ken Kavanaugh (1992)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 525048-526528 / y 5018312-5020816, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release ogc-data, exportImage.6.tiff)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, same box, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release ogc-data, exportImage.7.tiff)
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1,100 x 2,120 m) + about 90 m of scenery on every side, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred. Taller than the runbook's 2,048 m limit because the course itself is 2,120 m north-south; approved by the developer 2026-10-19

remove_wires.note: the canopy model holds the BPA transmission lines across the course and the Willamette, and distribution lines along the roads; s05 removes them before finding trees

scorecard_source: GolfPass scorecard (golfpass.com/courses/1366-the-oregon-golf-club/scorecard-and-layout), retrieved 2026-10-19; unverified third-party listing, no printed card available (developer). Blue and White hole sums match the printed Out/In totals; the tee table says White 6,081 where the holes add to 6,080. Pars and men's stroke index agree with the OSM hole tags. Full card in scorecard_full.csv
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
notes: Developer, 2026-10-19: world may exceed 2,048 m; Blue and White tees, Blue default; all water hazards red; the driving range holds target greens P3-P9 of proposed/osm_labelled.png (range polygon proposed from the OSM path loop, proposed/range.png); no printed scorecard; pnw theme; wind as Oswego Lake and Tualatin.

drop_trees.reason: developer 2026-10-19: hole 7, 31 m fir 7 m in front of the green; its sprite covered the pin in the 3/4 view; removed for playability
